name: Mukradi Jar
text:
Activate 2 (manipulate)

---
A miniature mukradi, its chitin shrunken and pale, is coiled within this jar. Its hollow form grows to a Gargantuan shell when you open the jar. It emits one of three breath weapons, chosen by you. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 34 basic Reflex save.
- Acid Maw (acid) 10-foot-wide, 60-foot line of acid dealing 12d6 acid. DC 34 basic Reflex save
- Flame Maw (fire) 60-foot cone of fire dealing 12d6 fire. DC 34 basic Reflex save
- Shock Maw (electricity) 120-foot line of electricity dealing 12d6 electricity. DC 34 basic Reflex save

---
Craft Requirements Supply a mukradi corpse.
